biocs.name: WMIC Remote Command Execution
biocs.description: Detection of wmic.exe being invoked with command-line arguments that indicate remote command execution or process creation
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'wmic.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'win32_process call create'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'powershell.exe'
